conceptZh: 風會吹動東西，我們看不見它
object: a wind-up animal band with a bunny, a bear and a duck, plus a kite
morph: two band halves pull a streamer in opposite directions until strokes spring together into 風
creativeAngle: 發條樂團兩邊拉布條，風一吹就把風箏、筆畫吹成字。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 風 (wind). Lead: a wind-up band of a bunny with cymbals, a bear with a drum and a duck with a horn, keys turning on their backs. Moment 1 (0-1.7s): the band tries to start, the horn honks and a gust blows the drummer sideways; the voice says 風. Moment 2 (1.7-3.4s): bunny and bear tug a long ribbon in opposite directions; the gust blows the ribbon into 風 on the second 風, the strokes snapping like elastic. Moment 3 (3.4-5.3s): the ribbon becomes the tail of a red diamond kite that lifts the duck; as the voice says 風箏 the kite loops high and the band waves from below. Moment 4 (5.3-8s): glyph still; the bear sways with the wind, drum rolling silently. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "風、風、風箏" (ㄈㄥ、ㄈㄥ、ㄈㄥ ㄓㄥ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops; no other speech, no music louder than the voice. The only on-screen text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 風, drawn as saturated solid teal blue strokes on a pale warm cream background, correctly formed, centered, filling about 70% of frame height with margins, perfectly still for the final 3-second hold while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. No vocabulary text, subtitles, watermark, clutter, flashing, real people or realistic humans; bright but not neon, no dark grading.
